contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (10,421.17) on the SUMMARY PAGE, which on this filing is the LAST page (p8, located by its printed heading); the same figure is printed as 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' at the foot of all three Schedule A sheets, and again at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: 52 Schedule A rows over three sheets sum to 10,421.17 EXACTLY, and each sheet's rows sum to its own printed 'Subtotal for this page' to the cent: p2 4,167.95 (18 rows in 17 printed lines) + p3 836.48 (17) + p4 5,416.74 (17) = 10,421.17 = the schedule's printed grand total = the cover's PROMOTED PER-PERIOD cell, Column A = summary line 4 = line 5. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the same 10,421.17 because this is the cycle's first report (Seven days preceding the Primary); it is retained as cumulative and never summed as an increment. The ladder closes independently: line 3 is a SLASHED ZERO = 0 under the zero-glyph ruling, and 10,421.17 - 9,464.37 = 956.80 = line 7 exactly.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (9,464.37) on the p8 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the printed 'Total Expenditures (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' at the foot of all three Schedule B sheets and summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 45 Schedule B rows over three sheets sum to 9,467.34 against the printed 9,464.37 - a delta of +2.97, the ROWS EXCEEDING the filer's own figures. The page-subtotal gate TRACES it to a single sheet and no other: p5's 17 rows sum to 2,676.00 against its printed 'Subtotal for this page' 2,673.03, SHORT BY 2.97 in the filer's addition; p6's 17 rows sum to 5,485.68 = printed subtotal 5,485.68 EXACT (after row 11 was corrected 28.00 -> 218.00 by escalation, see escalation_note); p7's 11 rows sum to 1,305.66 = printed subtotal 1,305.66 EXACT. The filer's own three printed subtotals add to his printed grand total exactly (2,673.03 + 5,485.68 + 1,305.66 = 9,464.37), so the discrepancy sits between his p5 rows and his p5 addition, not in his carry-forward. NOTHING WAS NUDGED: all 17 amount cells on p5 were escalated to tight 900 dpi cell crops and every one reproduced its full-page reading (12.00 / 748.80 / 1.00 / 648.22 / 189.20 / 214.00 / 218.00 / 25.00 / 30.00 / 25.00 / 50.00 / 53.36 / 6.05 / 6.61 / 184.74 / 189.02 / 75.00), so no cell can absorb the 2.97 - the ADDENDUM G6 standard. Trap F1.5 was ruled out on p5 by the one-past-the-end crop, which rendered the printed subtotal and nothing else. The correlated-error screen is inconclusive by absence: this is the only Sakievich filing in the chunk, and the filing's other five sheets all close exactly, so the slip is a one-off rather than a habit.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on the contributions side - both conventions tested on both sides, as ADDENDUM G1 requires. Exactly ONE Schedule A row is in-kind (line 52, the 10.50 Rotary lunch, which the filer marks with an asterisk and explains in his own footnote below the grid); monetary-only would give 10,410.67 and FAILS Column A by that 10.50, while monetary-plus-in-kind gives 10,421.17 and closes to the cent against Column A, the schedule's printed grand total and every page subtotal. Schedule B marks no row in-kind, so both conventions are identical there and neither closes the +2.97 delta.
escalation_note: ONE figure was corrected: p6 row 11 read 28.00 on the full page and is 218.00 - the leading '2' is pushed left of '18' by the filer's '(x1000)' annotation written above the line. Confirmed BOTH by the glyph at 900 dpi AND by unique arithmetic closure (218.00 makes p6 sum to its printed subtotal 5,485.68 exactly), which is the ADDENDUM F6 standard. Beyond that: all 17 p5 amount cells were escalated and every one reproduced its full-page reading, leaving the +2.97 unattributable and unnudged; the p2 band-9 and p7 band-4 double-occupancy was proved by splitting each band and rendering the two figures separately; and eighteen geometry control crops were taken (first row, last row and one-past-the-end on each of the six schedule sheets). No name was corrected - line 44's surname is flagged rather than settled.
